rules.cue: Use comfortable close-range attempts to test a coordinated rise and ball lift, then compare repeated attempts.
Complete the release with comfortable extension and briefly retain a relaxed finish during close-range practice.
rules.causal_limit: Post-release movement does not change a ball already in flight. This cue must be assessed through its relationship to repeatability around release.

rules.scope: matched stationary jump shots with visible feet and trunk
rules.cue: Compare balance and landing across attempts at the same location before deciding whether a change is useful.

global_constraints: Reference similarity alone cannot establish a technical error.
Do not infer a unique movement fault from make/miss or miss direction.
Unknown or occluded measurements remain null.
Do not turn published teaching cues into universal cross-person angle thresholds.
